_comment: OrigamChartPareto component tokens — issue #503 (Paquet 1, cause C: no file existed). Values copied verbatim from the SCSS fallbacks already present in OrigamChartPareto.vue (zero visual change by construction). Shared chart.json vars (--origam-chart---*, --origam-chart__title/subtitle/body/tooltip/empty/legend*---*) are OUT of this file's scope — chart.json exists already and its registration is tracked by #436-A, not #503.

stroke.$description: Fallback var(--origam-color-border-subtle, #e5e7eb) in the SCSS references a legacy single-dash semantic name never emitted by the current pipeline — it always falls through to this literal hex. No origam primitive/semantic token carries #e5e7eb, so the literal is kept as-is (foreign Tailwind-gray palette, out of scope to remap).
Same legacy-fallback situation as grid.stroke — no origam token matches #d1d5db.

stroke-color.$description: Fallback var(--origam-color-surface-default, #ffffff) — the legacy ref name is stale but the literal #ffffff DOES match color.surface.default (neutral.0), so the semantic token is used.

font-size.$description: No font.size.* primitive matches 0.6875rem (11px) — kept literal.

fill.$description: Legacy stale ref var(--origam-color-text-secondary, #6b7280) — no origam token matches #6b7280.

font-weight.$description: Literal fallback was 600, which matches font.weight.semibold exactly.

fill.$description: Fallback var(--origam-color-text-primary, currentColor) — deepest fallback is the CSS keyword currentColor, kept as-is (no color scale applies to a keyword).
